name: Gamora

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.True Strike: Saldırılar Zırh, Direnç, Otomatik Blok ve Kaçışı (Evade) yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Deadliest Woman In The Galaxy
Gamora's skill with the Godslayer Blade grows, increasing the chance to activate it during Special Attacks to 100%. Additionally, the cooldown is reduced to [50 - 20] seconds.

abilitySections.title: Light Attacks
content: 65% chance to gain a Fury Buff, granting +[1,689.44] Attack Rating for 14 seconds. Max: 25.

abilitySections.title: Medium Attacks
content: 65% chance to gain a Cruelty Buff, increasing Critical Damage Rating by [85.05] for 14 seconds. Max: 25.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Gamora's personal Buffs gain +1.5% duration for every 1 seconds that have passed during the fight. Max bonus: +60%.
If Gamora has 8 or more personal Buffs active, her attacks cannot Miss.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Refreshes the duration of all personal Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks - Godslayer Strike
content: Gamora begins each fight with a Godslayer Strike ready, which has a 65% chance to activate during each Special Attack. Once Godslayer Strike is used, it goes on Cooldown for 100 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack has 100% Critical Hit Chance.
100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [10,559] Direct Damage over 5 seconds.
Godslayer: Attack gains a flat +600% Critical Damage Multiplier.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack has 100% Critical Hit Chance.
80% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by [523.81] for 18 seconds.
Godslayer: Armor Break Debuffs during the attack gain +50% Potency, +60% Duration and +150% Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% Chance to gain a True Strike Buff for 14 seconds, allowing this Champion to ignore Armor, Resistances, Auto-Block and all Evade effects.
Godslayer: 100% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff causing [21,118] Energy Damage over 10 seconds. If the opponent is a Robot, instead inflict a Degeneration Debuff that deals double damage.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Deadliest Woman In The Galaxy
content: Gamora's skill with the Godslayer Blade grows, increasing the chance to activate it during Special Attacks to 100%. Additionally, the cooldown is reduced to [50 - 20] seconds.
